items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Later, after hearing Erroll Garner, I really began to feel that way about him.

ctx.x: He was just one of those other people that I just felt like was a genius. I mentioned years ago about this fellow Toby Walker. Well, Charlie Parker was another one of those people that just had something different about him. I just never met anyone like that. Of course, I've always felt like Art Tatum had that same kind of a thing. There were just things that were beyond understanding of what or how he did them, or how they came about, or how they came to be. Because it certainly wasn't a lot of things that you…
Later, after hearing Erroll Garner, I really began to feel that way about him. And I want to talk about Erroll Garner a little later.
